reddit.title: Trying LibreFolio, an open-source portfolio tracker
reddit.message:
I've been looking for a simpler way to follow my investments without handing all my portfolio data to an external service. Lately I've been trying LibreFolio, and I'm enjoying having everything in one place.

It's an open-source portfolio tracker to organize your holdings and explore their performance, while keeping your data under your control. If that sounds useful, take a look!
reddit.hint: We open a text post with a separate title and body. If Reddit leaves the body empty, paste the text already copied.

facebook.message:
Lately I've been using LibreFolio to keep an eye on my investments, and I like having everything in one place without giving up control of my data.

If you're looking for an open-source portfolio tracker that keeps your data under your control, give it a look!
facebook.hint: Facebook prepares only the link preview. After opening it, paste the copied text into the post's message field.
facebook.afterCopy: Text and link copied. Paste the text into Facebook's post message.

instagram.message: A little more order in my investments, without leaving my data elsewhere. I'm trying LibreFolio, an open-source portfolio tracker.
instagram.hint: Instagram cannot prepare a post from this link. After opening it, choose Create (+), select a photo or video, then paste the copied caption.
instagram.afterCopy: Caption and link copied. On Instagram: Create (+), choose your photo/video, then paste the caption.

tiktok.message: My new sidekick for tracking my portfolio: LibreFolio. Open source, with my data under my control. If you like tinkering, check it out!

reason.https: Encrypted with HTTPS: your browser considers this connection secure.
reason.localhost: You are on the server itself: the traffic does not leave this computer.
reason.vpn: Encrypted by the VPN (Tailscale) between your device and the server.
reason.lan: Local network without encryption: anyone on the same network, for example the Wi-Fi, can read the traffic. For the best security, use the HTTPS address at home too.
reason.uncertain: Unclear: the address you opened and the source the server sees disagree, for example a public name reached through split DNS or a local proxy. The traffic is not encrypted: use the HTTPS address.
reason.internet: Not encrypted over the Internet: passwords and data travel in clear text.

connectionSecurity.cookieWarning: Your browser uses HTTPS, but the session cookie is not marked Secure. Make the reverse proxy send X-Forwarded-Proto (Nginx: proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;), or set SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE back to auto if it is never.
